frequency_question: What proportion of industry-wide labor dispute escalation cycles in the banking sector result in an indefinite strike within a 60-day observation window from notice?
membership_rule: Includes formalized industry-wide strike notices or ballots by dominant multi-union coalitions representing bank employees in major economies resulting in strike action or settlement within 60 days. Excludes localized, single-institution, or non-banking labor disputes.
